tasks.title: Auth: signup → OTP (10-min expiry, Resend onboarding@resend.dev, custom HTML) → verify → login → session cookie → logout
tasks.notes: Auth validated live on forgehouse50.pages.dev: signup creates unverified profile + 10-min OTP; wrong OTP rejected ("Incorrect code"), correct OTP consumed (single-use, re-use returns "No active verification code"), 30-day HttpOnly+Secure+SameSite=Lax session cookie issued; /api/auth/me resolves session with stats; login rejects wrong password (401 "Invalid email or password", no enumeration) and accepts correct; logout destroys session (me -> 401). OTP codes are single-use, expire in 10 min, max 5 attempts. Resend: free-tier onboarding@resend.dev can only deliver to account owner (vjumbo264@gmail.com) until a domain is verified; E2E OTP read from D1 directly. Password hashing PBKDF2-SHA256 100k iters via Web Crypto (documented in auth.mjs).
